articles.title_en: Exhaustive or exhausting? Evidence on respondent fatigue in long surveys
articles.title_cn: 详尽还是令人疲惫？关于长问卷中受访者疲劳的证据
articles.abstract_en: Living standards measurement surveys require sustained attention for several hours. We quantify survey fatigue by randomizing the order of questions in 2–3 hour-long in-person surveys. An additional hour of survey time increases the probability that a respondent skips a question by 10%–64%. Because skips are more common, the total monetary value of aggregated categories such as assets or expenditures declines as the survey goes on, and this effect is sizeable for some categories: for example, an extra hour of survey time lowers food expenditures by 25%. We find similar effect sizes within phone surveys in which respondents were already familiar with questions, suggesting that cognitive burden may be a key driver of survey fatigue.
articles.abstract_cn: 生活水平测量调查要求受访者持续专注数小时。我们通过随机化2-3小时面对面调查中问题的顺序来量化调查疲劳。每增加一小时的调查时间，受访者跳过某个问题的概率会增加10%–64%。由于跳答更为常见，资产或支出等汇总类别的总货币价值随调查进行而下降，且这一效应对某些类别影响显著：例如，额外一小时的调查时间会使食品支出降低25%。我们在受访者已熟悉问题的电话调查中也发现了类似的效应大小，这表明认知负担可能是调查疲劳的关键驱动因素。

articles.title_en: Irrigation and the spatial pattern of local economic development in India
articles.title_cn: 灌溉与印度地方经济发展的空间格局
articles.abstract_en: We study the long-term impact of large-scale irrigation infrastructure on the composition of local economic activity in India. Our analysis uses high-resolution spatial data covering approximately 150,000 villages and towns and exploits spatial discontinuities in the coverage of irrigation projects. Irrigation increases agricultural output, wealth, and population density in rural villages. However, in towns it reduces population and nightlight density, the size of the non-agricultural sector, and large-firm activity. These results highlight the heterogeneous impacts that agricultural productivity gains can have on the patterns local economic development.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们研究了大规模灌溉基础设施对印度地方经济活动构成的长期影响。我们的分析使用了覆盖约150000万个村庄和城镇的高分辨率空间数据，并利用了灌溉项目覆盖范围的空间不连续性。灌溉提高了农村村庄的农业产出、财富和人口密度。然而，在城镇中，它降低了人口和夜间灯光密度、非农业部门的规模以及大型企业的活动。这些结果凸显了农业生产力提升对地方经济发展模式可能产生的异质性影响。

articles.title_en: No bulls: Experimental evidence on the impact of veterinarian ratings in Pakistan
articles.title_cn: 没有公牛：巴基斯坦兽医评级影响的实验证据
articles.abstract_en: We implement a platform to crowdsource information about service provision quality and prices charged and reveal this information to consumers in a market – artificial insemination of livestock in Punjab, Pakistan – where individual signals of quality are noisy. We measure the impact of this information revelation using a randomized controlled trial. Farmers receiving information enjoy 25% higher insemination success and no higher prices than controls. These effects are due to existing veterinarians increasing effort, rather than farmers switching to possibly higher-quality providers. These results illustrate the viability of information clearinghouses successfully aggregating information in low-capacity markets. They also suggest the importance of doing so by implying large welfare benefits from our low-cost information intervention.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们实施了一个平台，以众包方式收集服务提供质量和收费价格的信息，并将这些信息透露给市场中的消费者——巴基斯坦旁遮普省的家畜人工授精市场——在该市场中，个体质量信号是嘈杂的。我们通过随机对照试验来衡量这种信息揭示的影响。收到信息的农民享有25%更高的授精成功率，且价格不高于对照组。这些效应是由于现有兽医增加了努力，而非农民转向可能更高质量的提供者。这些结果说明了信息清算所在低能力市场中成功聚合信息的可行性。它们也表明了这样做的必要性，因为我们的低成本信息干预带来了巨大的福利收益。

articles.title_en: Subjective risk belief function in the field: Evidence from cooking fuel choices and health in India
articles.title_cn: 实地中的主观风险信念函数：来自印度烹饪燃料选择与健康的证据
articles.abstract_en: We investigate the accuracy of the perceptions of health risks in India. The context of our study is the risk of developing physical symptoms related to household air pollution caused by cooking. Using field data collected from 588 respondents in 17 villages in West Bengal, we regress the probability of symptoms on fuel choices to predict respondent-specific health risk changes. The estimated risks, which we treat as objective risks, are then compared with the corresponding subjective probabilistic beliefs, which are elicited by an interactive method with visual aids. Our results show that, on average, the respondents slightly underestimate the change in risk when switching from cooking with firewood to cooking with liquefied petroleum gas, even though their beliefs are qualitatively correct. The results further show that risk misperception is associated only with religion among individuals’ observed characteristics, suggesting that their unobserved characteristics play a substantial role in risk misperception.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们研究了印度健康风险感知的准确性。我们的研究背景是烹饪引起的家庭空气污染导致身体症状发展的风险。利用从西孟加拉邦17个村庄的588名受访者收集的实地数据，我们将症状概率对燃料选择进行回归，以预测受访者特定的健康风险变化。我们将估计的风险视为客观风险，然后将其与相应的主观概率信念进行比较，这些信念是通过带有视觉辅助工具的互动方法引发的。我们的结果表明，平均而言，受访者在从柴火烹饪转向液化石油气烹饪时略微低估了风险变化，尽管他们的信念在定性上是正确的。结果进一步表明，风险误解仅与个体观察特征中的宗教相关，这表明他们的未观察特征在风险误解中发挥了重要作用。

articles.title_en: Rethinking the Lebanese economic miracle: The extreme concentration of income and wealth in Lebanon, 2005–2014
articles.title_cn: 重新思考黎巴嫩经济奇迹：黎巴嫩收入与财富的极端集中，2005-2014年
articles.abstract_en: I combine household surveys, national accounts and unique personal income tax records to produce the first estimates of the national income distribution in an Arab country, Lebanon. I find that income is extremely concentrated over the 2005–2014 period: The top 1 and 10 percent of the adult population received almost 25 and 55 percent of national income on average, placing Lebanon among the countries with the highest levels of income inequality in the world. These results challenge a long lasting narrative according to which inequality levels are not that high in the Middle East. They also confirm results from a large literature that emphasizes how the Lebanese sectarian-based mode of governance has allowed the ruling elite to extract large rents for decades and at the expense of the majority of citizens.
articles.abstract_cn: 我结合家庭调查、国民账户和独特的个人所得税记录，首次估算了阿拉伯国家黎巴嫩的国民收入分配情况。我发现，在2005-2014年期间，收入极度集中：最富有的1和10%的成年人口平均获得了国民收入的近25和55%，使黎巴嫩跻身于世界上收入不平等程度最高的国家之列。这些结果挑战了长期以来认为中东不平等程度不高的说法。它们也证实了大量文献的研究结果，这些文献强调黎巴嫩基于教派的政治治理模式使得统治精英能够数十年来以牺牲大多数公民的利益为代价获取巨额租金。

articles.title_en: Measuring remittances
articles.title_cn: 衡量汇款
articles.abstract_en: Remittances received by households from international migrants are of interest in an increasing number of microeconomic analyses. Making use of novel data, we measure misreporting of remittances sent by migrants in the United Arab Emirates (UAE) to remittance recipients in the Philippines. We obtained administrative transaction data from a sample of Filipino migrants who were clients of a popular money transfer operator (MTO). We then surveyed these migrants as well as their primary remittance recipients about the same remittance flows. Migrant-reported remittances are only 6% lower than MTO administrative records, and we cannot reject their equality. A custom smartphone app designed to facilitate migrant remittance reporting does not help raise reporting accuracy. Recipient-reported remittances are 23% lower than migrant reports on average. Recipients under-report even more when they receive remittances less frequently and when remittances make up a lower share of household income.
articles.abstract_cn: 家庭从国际移民那里收到的汇款在越来越多的微观经济分析中受到关注。利用新颖的数据，我们衡量了在阿拉伯联合酋长国（UAE）的移民向菲律宾汇款接收者报告的汇款误报情况。我们从一家受欢迎的汇款运营商（MTO）的客户中获取了菲律宾移民样本的行政交易数据。然后，我们对这些移民及其主要汇款接收者就相同的汇款流进行了调查。移民报告的汇款仅比MTO行政记录低6%，且我们不能拒绝它们相等的假设。一个旨在促进移民汇款报告的定制智能手机应用程序并未帮助提高报告准确性。接收者报告的汇款平均比移民报告低23%。当接收者收到汇款的频率较低且汇款占家庭收入的比例较低时，他们更可能少报汇款。

articles.title_en: Tax revenue and mobile money in developing countries
articles.title_cn: 税收收入与发展中国家的移动货币
articles.abstract_en: This paper analyzes the effect of mobile money adoption on tax revenue performance in a large sample of 104 developing countries over the period 1990–2019. Estimations, based on the entropy balancing method, show that mobile money significantly increases tax revenue in mobile money countries relative to non-mobile money countries. This result remains robust to various robustness tests and may depend on time perspective, the type of mobile money service, and some structural factors, including a country's level of development, corruption level, rural population size, inflation rate, education level, tax revenue sample 25th percentile and average, revenue administration efficiency, and mature markets. A first level of disaggregation of tax revenue into direct and indirect tax revenue shows that mobile money increases both types of tax revenue, with a larger impact on direct tax revenue. A second level of disaggregation of these two components into different sub-categories shows that the effect on direct tax revenue is driven by personal income tax revenue and corporate income tax revenue and that on indirect tax revenue is determined by taxes on goods and services. Finally, a broadening tax base (proxied by GDP per capita), better institutional quality, and tax payment process simplification are the main channels through which mobile money adoption increases tax performance in developing countries.
articles.abstract_cn: 本文分析了在1990-2019年间，104个发展中国家的大样本中，移动货币采用对税收收入绩效的影响。基于熵平衡方法的估计显示，相对于非移动货币国家，移动货币显著增加了移动货币国家的税收收入。这一结果在各种稳健性检验中保持稳健，并可能取决于时间视角、移动货币服务的类型以及一些结构性因素，包括国家的发展水平、腐败程度、农村人口规模、通货膨胀率、教育水平、税收收入样本25百分位数和平均值、税收管理效率以及成熟市场。将税收收入首次分解为直接税和间接税收入，显示移动货币增加了两种类型的税收收入，对直接税收入的影响更大。将这两个组成部分进一步分解为不同子类别，显示对直接税收入的影响由个人所得税收入和企业所得税收入驱动，而对间接税收入的影响则由商品和服务税决定。最后，扩大税基（以人均GDP为代表）、更好的制度质量和简化纳税流程是移动货币采用提高发展中国家税收绩效的主要渠道。

articles.title_en: Military investment and the rise of industrial clusters: Evidence from China’s self-strengthening movement
articles.title_cn: 军事投资与产业集群的兴起：来自中国自强运动的证据
articles.abstract_en: This paper investigates the short- and long-term impact of large-scale military investment on civilian industrial growth by focusing on China’s first attempt to modernize its military sector between 1861 and 1894. Panel data from 1858 to 1937 suggest that the program generated positive effects on civilian firm entry, but these effects appeared only after the government relaxed constraints on the entry of private firms. Long-term analysis shows that counties that received more military investment through the program, driven by plausibly exogenous ex ante political connections, had greater output in civilian industries in the 1930s. Analysis of the mechanisms suggest that the program boosted local economies through input–output linkages, human capital accumulation, and the rise of modern banks.
articles.abstract_cn: 本文通过聚焦中国在1861年至1894年间首次尝试现代化其军事部门，研究了大规模军事投资对民用工业增长的短期和长期影响。1858年至1937年的面板数据表明，该计划对民用企业进入产生了积极影响，但这些影响仅在政府放宽对私营企业进入的限制后才显现。长期分析显示，通过该计划获得更多军事投资的县，受可能外生的先前政治关系驱动，在1930年民用工业产出更高。机制分析表明，该计划通过投入产出联系、人力资本积累和现代银行的兴起促进了地方经济。

articles.title_en: Program targeting with machine learning and mobile phone data: Evidence from an anti-poverty intervention in Afghanistan
articles.title_cn: 利用机器学习和手机数据进行项目瞄准：来自阿富汗反贫困干预的证据
articles.abstract_en: Can mobile phone data improve program targeting? By combining rich survey data from a “big push” anti-poverty program in Afghanistan with detailed mobile phone logs from program beneficiaries, we study the extent to which machine learning methods can accurately differentiate ultra-poor households eligible for program benefits from ineligible households. We show that machine learning methods leveraging mobile phone data can identify ultra-poor households nearly as accurately as survey-based measures of consumption and wealth; and that combining survey-based measures with mobile phone data produces classifications more accurate than those based on a single data source.
articles.abstract_cn: 手机数据能否改善项目瞄准？通过将阿富汗一项“大推动”反贫困项目的丰富调查数据与项目受益人的详细手机日志相结合，我们研究了机器学习方法在多大程度上能够准确区分符合项目受益资格的极端贫困家庭与不符合资格的家庭。我们表明，利用手机数据的机器学习方法识别极端贫困家庭的准确度几乎与基于调查的消费和财富衡量标准相当；并且将基于调查的衡量标准与手机数据相结合，产生的分类比基于单一数据源的分类更准确。

articles.title_en: Delivery times in international competition: An empirical investigation
articles.title_cn: 国际竞争中的交货时间：一项实证研究
articles.abstract_en: This paper investigates the role of timely delivery in international competition. Using a demand-side, industry-specific measure of time-sensitivity, we assess the effect of Chinese competition on the export performance of Eastern European transition economies into Western European (EU15) destination-product markets. Our empirical analysis relies on exploiting the increase of Chinese competition in global markets during the first decade of the 2000s. We find evidence of heterogeneous adjustments to Chinese competition among Eastern European exporters due to the differential importance of timely delivery across sectors (i.e. time-sensitivity). While we observe sizable real displacement effects, they appear to be at least 50 percent smaller for time-sensitive exports. Relying on firm-level customs data, we establish that this mechanism also plays a role for responses to Chinese competition within firms.
articles.abstract_cn: 本文研究了及时交货在国际竞争中的作用。利用需求侧、行业特定的时间敏感性衡量指标，我们评估了中国竞争对东欧转型经济体向西欧（EU15）目的地产品市场出口绩效的影响。我们的实证分析依赖于利用全球市场上中国竞争在2000年代头十年的加剧。我们发现，由于及时交货在不同行业（即时间敏感性）中的重要性不同，东欧出口商对中国竞争的调整存在异质性证据。虽然我们观察到相当大的实际替代效应，但对于时间敏感型出口，这些效应至少小50%。利用企业层面的海关数据，我们确定这一机制在企业内部对中国竞争的反应中也起作用。

articles.title_en: Measuring consumption over the phone: Evidence from a survey experiment in urban Ethiopia
articles.title_cn: 通过电话测量消费：来自埃塞俄比亚城市调查实验的证据
articles.abstract_en: The paucity of reliable, timely household consumption data in many low- and middle-income countries have made it difficult to assess how global poverty has evolved during the COVID-19 pandemic. Standard poverty measurement requires collecting household consumption data, which is rarely collected by phone. To test the feasibility of collecting consumption data over the phone, we conducted a survey experiment in urban Ethiopia, randomly assigning households to either phone or in-person interviews. In the phone survey, average per capita consumption is 23 percent lower and the estimated poverty headcount is twice as high than in the in-person survey. We observe evidence of survey fatigue occurring early in phone interviews but not in in-person interviews; the bias is correlated with household characteristics. While the phone survey mode provides comparable estimates when measuring diet-based food security, it is not amenable to measuring consumption using the ‘best practice’ approach originally devised for in-person surveys.
articles.abstract_cn: 在许多低收入和中等收入国家，可靠、及时的家庭消费数据的匮乏使得评估全球贫困在COVID-19大流行期间如何演变变得困难。标准的贫困测量需要收集家庭消费数据，而这很少通过电话收集。为了测试通过电话收集消费数据的可行性，我们在埃塞俄比亚城市进行了一项调查实验，将家庭随机分配到电话访谈或面对面访谈。在电话调查中，人均消费平均低23%，估计的贫困人口比例是面对面调查的两倍。我们观察到电话访谈早期出现调查疲劳的证据，但面对面访谈中没有；这种偏差与家庭特征相关。虽然电话调查模式在测量基于饮食的食品安全时提供了可比较的估计，但它不适合使用最初为面对面调查设计的‘最佳实践’方法来测量消费。

articles.title_en: The freedom to choose: Theory and quasi-experimental evidence on cash transfer restrictions
articles.title_cn: 选择的自由：现金转移限制的理论与准实验证据
articles.abstract_en: Should cash transfer programmes restrict consumer choice? For example, should food assistance delivered in cash be restricted to food and exclude temptation goods? Theoretically, restrictions induce (1) a substitution effect away from restricted goods and (2) a negative wealth effect if transfers are extra-marginal and the resale of goods is costly. The welfare impact on transfer recipients is negative. We test these predictions by exploiting a natural experiment in a refugee settlement in Kenya, where some refugees receive monthly cash transfers restricted to food while others receive unrestricted transfers. In line with theory, we find that restricted transfers increase participation in a shadow resale market and negatively affect non-food expenditure, temptation-goods spending, and subjective well-being. Consistent with theory, restrictions have no significant effect on food consumption. Our results show that policy-makers should avoid restrictions to maximise positive impacts on transfer beneficiaries, especially when extreme poverty implies that transfers are extra-marginal.
articles.abstract_cn: 现金转移计划是否应限制消费者的选择？例如，以现金形式提供的食品援助是否应仅限于食品并排除诱惑品？理论上，限制会引发（1）远离受限商品的替代效应，以及（2）如果转移是超边际的且商品转售成本高昂，则会产生负财富效应。对转移接受者的福利影响是负面的。我们通过利用肯尼亚一个难民定居点中的自然实验来检验这些预测，在该实验中，一些难民每月收到仅限于食品的现金转移，而另一些则收到无限制的转移。与理论一致，我们发现受限转移增加了影子转售市场的参与，并对非食品支出、诱惑品消费和主观幸福感产生负面影响。与理论一致，限制对食品消费没有显著影响。我们的结果表明，政策制定者应避免限制，以最大化对转移受益者的积极影响，尤其是在极端贫困意味着转移是超边际的情况下。

articles.title_en: Firms and inequality when unemployment is high
articles.title_cn: 高失业率下的企业与不平等
articles.abstract_en: How important are firms for wage inequality in developing countries where structural unemployment is high? Research focused on contexts close to full employment has suggested a substantial role of firms in labor market inequality. Using matched employer–employee data from South Africa, I find that firms explain a larger share of wage variation than in richer countries. I consider drivers of this, documenting first a higher productivity dispersion as found for other developing countries. Secondly, I estimate the separations elasticity by instrumenting wages of matched workers with firm wages, and I find a low separations elasticity. This generates a high degree of monopsony, and the correspondingly high estimated rent-sharing elasticity helps explain the important role of firm wage policies in inequality. Monopsony may be driven by higher unemployment, and regional heterogeneity provides suggestive evidence for this. Such firm-level competitive dynamics may exacerbate inequality in developing countries more generally.
articles.abstract_cn: 在结构性失业率较高的发展中国家，企业对工资不平等的影响有多大？聚焦于接近充分就业环境的研究表明，企业在劳动力市场不平等中扮演着重要角色。利用南非的匹配雇主-雇员数据，我发现企业解释的工资差异份额高于较富裕国家。我探讨了其驱动因素，首先记录了与其他发展中国家类似的更高的生产率离散度。其次，我通过使用企业工资作为匹配工人工资的工具变量来估计离职弹性，发现离职弹性较低。这产生了高度的买方垄断，相应估计的高租金分享弹性有助于解释企业工资政策在不平等中的重要作用。买方垄断可能由较高的失业率驱动，区域异质性为此提供了提示性证据。这种企业层面的竞争动态可能普遍加剧发展中国家的不平等。

articles.title_en: Sharing risk to avoid tragedy: Informal insurance and irrigation in village economies
articles.title_cn: 分担风险以避免悲剧：村庄经济中的非正式保险与灌溉
articles.abstract_en: Irrigation provides insurance against aggregate weather shocks, which can interact with other institutions functioning in village communities. I study this relationship in a model of joint co-operation over irrigation and risk sharing under limited commitment. The model dynamics show that if access to irrigation can be regulated by villagers, the two institutions reinforce each other. However, non-excludable irrigation crowds out risk sharing (as is the case with government-managed irrigation). I estimate the framework on data from three villages in India and use it to quantify the relationship between informal insurance and irrigation, and the welfare impact of irrigation public policy.
articles.abstract_cn: 灌溉为应对总体天气冲击提供了保险，这可能与村庄社区中运作的其他制度相互作用。我在一个有限承诺下关于灌溉和风险分担的联合合作模型中研究了这种关系。模型动态表明，如果村民能够调节灌溉的获取，这两种制度会相互加强。然而，非排他性的灌溉会挤出风险分担（如政府管理的灌溉情况）。我在印度三个村庄的数据上估计了该框架，并用它来量化非正式保险与灌溉之间的关系，以及灌溉公共政策的福利影响。

articles.title_en: Student loans: Credit constraints and higher education in South Africa
articles.title_cn: 学生贷款：南非的信贷约束与高等教育
articles.abstract_en: The empirical evidence that enrollment in higher education is constrained by access to credit is limited and usually indirect. We use a regression discontinuity design based on the fact that student loans are granted according to a score threshold at a South African credit institution (Eduloan) providing short-term loans at market conditions: we find that the credit constraint is substantial, as it reduces enrollment by more than 40 percentage points in a population of mostly middle-class applicants. However, this effect is entirely concentrated on women, and women granted a loan catch up with men’s enrollment levels. This heterogeneity is not explained by lower incomes in the sample of women. It implies that women have lower access to credit, or that their options for managing without a credit are more limited than men’s.
articles.abstract_cn: 关于高等教育入学受信贷获取限制的经验证据有限且通常是间接的。我们利用基于南非一家信贷机构（Eduloan）按分数阈值发放学生贷款这一事实的断点回归设计，该机构以市场条件提供短期贷款：我们发现信贷约束相当显著，因为它使大多数中产阶级申请者群体的入学率降低了超过40个百分点。然而，这一效应完全集中在女性身上，而获得贷款的女性在入学水平上赶上了男性。这种异质性并不能用女性样本中较低的收入来解释。这意味着女性获得信贷的机会较少，或者她们在没有信贷的情况下应对的选择比男性更为有限。

articles.title_en: Can school environmental education programs make children and parents more pro-environmental?
articles.title_cn: 学校环境教育项目能否使儿童和家长更加环保？
articles.abstract_en: We evaluate the direct and indirect effects of an environmental educational program with value-laded content on children's and parents' knowledge, attitudes and practices regarding the consumption and disposal of plastics.We do this using a randomized field experiment targeting fourth-grade children in Chile.The educational program had a sizeable and a positive impact on children’ knowledge, attitudes, and practices, but no effect on parents' behavior.Heterogeneous effects indicate that the program had a larger effect among children in more vulnerable schools, but there was still no effect on parents.Finally, because parents may ultimately determine what constitutes acceptable behavior for children, promoting permanent changes in behavior will require interventions of this sort to be complemented with other initiatives targeting parents.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们评估了一个带有价值导向内容的环境教育项目对儿童和家长在塑料消费与处置方面的知识、态度和实践的直接和间接影响。我们通过一项针对智利四年级儿童的随机实地实验来进行此项评估。该教育项目对儿童的知识、态度和实践产生了显著且积极的影响，但对家长的行为没有影响。异质性效应表明，该项目在更弱势学校中的儿童中效果更大，但对家长仍然没有影响。最后，由于家长可能最终决定什么构成对儿童可接受的行为，促进行为的持久改变将需要此类干预措施与其他针对家长的举措相结合。

articles.title_en: The dynamics of poverty targeting
articles.title_cn: 贫困瞄准的动态变化
articles.abstract_en: Several recent papers have compared the ability of proxy-means testing (PMT) and community-based targeting (CBT) to identify consumption-poor households. Motivated by the facts that targeted benefits typically reach beneficiaries with a substantial time lag and that transitions into and out of poverty are frequent, we assess PMT’s and CBT’s performance during the years following the targeting exercise. With original data from Burkina Faso, we replicate the finding that PMT outperforms CBT at baseline. But this pattern disappears for households’ poverty status 12 and 30 months later where both methods perform equally well. For real-world welfare programs where benefits typically accrue with a substantial time lag, our results suggest that CBT’s targeting performance is better than commonly thought.
articles.abstract_cn: 最近几篇论文比较了代理家计调查（PMT）和社区瞄准（CBT）在识别消费贫困家庭方面的能力。鉴于针对性福利通常需要较长时间才能到达受益者手中，且贫困状态的进出频繁，我们评估了瞄准活动后几年内PMT和CBT的表现。利用布基纳法索的原始数据，我们重复了PMT在基线时优于CBT的发现。但在12个月和30个月后，这一模式在家庭贫困状态上消失，两种方法表现同样出色。对于实际福利项目而言，福利通常有显著的时间滞后，我们的结果表明CBT的瞄准性能比通常认为的要好。

articles.title_en: Social stigma as a barrier to HIV testing: Evidence from a randomized experiment in Mozambique
articles.title_cn: 社会污名作为HIV检测的障碍：来自莫桑比克随机实验的证据
articles.abstract_en: This paper shows that concerns about social stigma cause individuals to avoid HIV tests. People have inaccurate beliefs about the stigma environment but are open-minded about taking on new information. A simple message that shares the local community's true (low) degree of stigmatizing attitudes can help individuals overcome the stigma barrier and result in more testing. The information intervention led to 36% more HIV testing among those who had overestimated stigma. The treatment effect is comparable to that of a monetary incentive worth more than half of the daily cost of living.
articles.abstract_cn: 本文表明，对社会污名的担忧导致个体避免进行HIV检测。人们对污名环境存在不准确的信念，但愿意接受新信息。一条分享当地社区真实（低）污名化态度的简单信息可以帮助个体克服污名障碍，并导致更多检测。信息干预使那些高估污名的人HIV检测率增加了36%。处理效应与超过每日生活成本一半的货币激励相当。

articles.title_en: Macroeconomic outcomes in disaster-prone countries
articles.title_cn: 灾害多发国家的宏观经济结果
articles.abstract_en: Using a dynamic stochastic general equilibrium model, we study the channels through which natural disaster shocks affect macroeconomic outcomes and welfare in disaster-prone countries. We solve the model using Taylor projection, a solution method that is shown to deal effectively with high-impact weather shocks calibrated in accordance to empirical evidence. We find large and persistent effects of weather shocks that significantly impact the income convergence path of disaster-prone countries. Relative to non-disaster-prone countries, on average, these shocks cause a welfare loss equivalent to a permanent fall in consumption of 5.3 percent. Welfare gains to countries that self-finance investments in resilient public infrastructure are found to be small, and international aid has to be sizable to achieve significant welfare gains. In addition, it is more cost-effective for donors to contribute to the financing of resilience before the realization of disasters, rather than disbursing aid after their realization.
articles.abstract_cn: 利用动态随机一般均衡模型，我们研究了自然灾害冲击影响灾害多发国家宏观经济结果和福利的渠道。我们使用泰勒投影法求解模型，该方法被证明能有效处理根据经验证据校准的高影响天气冲击。我们发现天气冲击对灾害多发国家的收入趋同路径产生显著且持久的影响。相对于非灾害多发国家，平均而言，这些冲击造成的福利损失相当于消费永久性下降5.3%。对于自筹资金投资于韧性公共基础设施的国家，福利收益被发现很小，而国际援助必须相当可观才能实现显著的福利收益。此外，对于捐助者来说，在灾害发生前为韧性建设提供资金比在灾害发生后支付援助更具成本效益。

articles.title_en: Railways and cities in India
articles.title_cn: 铁路与印度城市
articles.abstract_en: Using a new dataset on city populations in colonial India, we show that the railroad network increased city size in the period 1881 to 1931. Our baseline estimation approach includes fixed effects for city and year, and we construct instrumental variables for railroad proximity based on distance from a least cost path spanning cities that existed prior to the start of railroad construction. Cities that increased market access due to the railroad grew. The small and heterogeneous effects we find are driven largely by cities that were initially small and isolated.
articles.abstract_cn: 利用关于殖民时期印度城市人口的新数据集，我们表明铁路网络在1881年至1931年间增加了城市规模。我们的基准估计方法包括城市和年份的固定效应，并基于与连接铁路建设前已存在城市的最小成本路径的距离，构建了铁路邻近度的工具变量。因铁路而增加市场准入的城市得以增长。我们发现的小且异质性的效应主要由最初规模较小且孤立的城市所驱动。

articles.title_en: Biased teachers and gender gap in learning outcomes: Evidence from India
articles.title_cn: 有偏见的教师与学习成果中的性别差距：来自印度的证据
articles.abstract_en: We investigate the effect of stereotypical beliefs of teachers on cognitive and non-cognitive outcomes of secondary school students in two states of India. We measure teacher’s bias through an index capturing teacher’s subjective beliefs about the role of gender in academic performance. We tackle the potential endogeneity of teacher’s subjective beliefs by controlling for teacher fixed effects in a value-added model that includes lagged test scores of students. We find that a standard deviation increase in the biased attitude of the math teacher increases the female disadvantage in math performance by 0.09 standard deviation over an academic year. We also find significant impacts on the gender gap in students’ math attitude, academic self-confidence, and effort as potential mechanisms for the effect on math score. We do not find any significant effect of English teachers’ gender bias on English learning of the students.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们调查了印度两个邦中学教师刻板信念对学生认知和非认知成果的影响。我们通过一个捕捉教师关于性别在学业表现中作用的主观信念的指数来衡量教师的偏见。我们通过在教学增值模型中控制教师固定效应，并纳入学生滞后测试成绩，来处理教师主观信念的潜在内生性。我们发现，数学教师偏见态度每增加一个标准差，会使女生在数学成绩上的劣势在一个学年内增加0.09个标准差。我们还发现，教师偏见对学生数学态度、学业自信和努力方面的性别差距有显著影响，这些可能是影响数学成绩的潜在机制。我们没有发现英语教师的性别偏见对学生的英语学习有任何显著影响。

articles.title_en: Lucky women in unlucky cohorts
articles.title_cn: 不幸队列中的幸运女性
articles.abstract_en: This paper assesses gender differences in the effects of adverse conditions at labor-market entry in a developing region. Using harmonized microdata from national household surveys for 15 Latin American countries, we build a synthetic panel of cohorts that potentially transition from school to work and observe their labor market outcomes 10 years later. We find that men who faced higher unemployment rates at ages 18–20 suffer a negative effect on employment at ages 27–30. In contrast, women from those same unlucky cohorts have higher employment rates and earnings. Our results are consistent with women acting as secondary workers in downturns. We also find that initial labor market conditions correlate with the role played by women within the household and to perceptions about gender roles later in life. Such higher empowerment could be a result of increased female labor participation and at the same time might act as a mechanism underlying the persistence of the positive effects on female labor outcomes.
articles.abstract_cn: 本文评估了发展中地区劳动力市场进入时不利条件对性别差异的影响。利用来自15个拉丁美洲国家全国住户调查的统一微观数据，我们构建了一个可能从学校过渡到工作的队列合成面板，并观察他们10年后的劳动力市场结果。我们发现，在18-20岁面临较高失业率的男性在27-30岁时的就业受到负面影响。相比之下，来自这些不幸队列的女性拥有更高的就业率和收入。我们的结果与女性在经济衰退中充当次要劳动者的角色一致。我们还发现，初始劳动力市场条件与女性在家庭中所扮演的角色以及后来对性别角色的看法相关。这种更高的赋权可能是女性劳动参与增加的结果，同时也可能是女性劳动结果积极影响持续存在的机制之一。

articles.title_en: How should the government bring small firms into the formal system? Experimental evidence from Malawi
articles.title_cn: 政府应如何将小企业纳入正式体系？来自马拉维的实验证据
articles.abstract_en: Governments seek to reduce pervasive firm informality for multiple reasons: taxes, firm growth, rule of law, and information. We conducted a randomized experiment in Malawi to test three alternatives to achieving these goals: a) helping firms obtain a business registration certificate that offers formal market access but imposes no tax obligations; b) helping firms obtain both business and tax registration; and c) supplementing business registration with a bank information session. We find incredibly high demand for obtaining a formal status that is separate from tax obligations, and very low take-up of tax registration. Business registration alone has no impact on formal market access or firm performance. However, combining registration assistance with the bank information session increases firm sales by 20 percent and profits by 15 percent. The results highlight the advantages of separating business and tax registration, but also the need to help firms benefit from their new formal status.
articles.abstract_cn: 政府寻求减少普遍存在的企业非正规性，原因有多种：税收、企业增长、法治和信息。我们在马拉维进行了一项随机实验，以测试实现这些目标的三种替代方案：a) 帮助企业获得营业执照，该证书提供正式市场准入但不施加纳税义务；b) 帮助企业同时获得商业和税务登记；c) 在商业登记之外补充银行信息说明会。我们发现，对获得与纳税义务分离的正式身份的需求极高，而税务登记的采纳率非常低。仅商业登记对正式市场准入或企业绩效没有影响。然而，将登记协助与银行信息说明会相结合，使企业销售额增加了20%，利润增加了15%。结果凸显了将商业登记与税务登记分开的优势，但也表明需要帮助企业从其新的正式身份中受益。

articles.title_en: Incentives, penalties, and rural air pollution: Evidence from satellite data
articles.title_cn: 激励、惩罚与农村空气污染：来自卫星数据的证据
articles.abstract_en: I test the role of economic incentives and command and control in reducing agricultural fires, a major source of air pollution in most rural regions across the world caused by burning crop residues after harvest. To tackle data shortage, I use high-resolution satellite data to construct a fine measure of agricultural fires as well as other geographic characteristics at 1 km × 1 km resolution for China. Using the staggered arrival of biomass power plants, which purchase crop residues as production inputs from nearby areas, as a shock to economic incentives, I find a more than 30% drop in agricultural fires in the vicinity of a plant after its opening relative to areas farther away. Such drop cannot be explained by structural transformation, migration, or enhanced regulation near the plant, and is consistent with an incentive-based explanation. I then examine the effectiveness of a command and control policy that bans agricultural fires within 15 km of airports. Using a spatial regression discontinuity design, I find no evidence that such policy works.
articles.abstract_cn: 我检验了经济激励和命令控制在减少农业火灾中的作用，农业火灾是收获后燃烧作物残留物造成的世界上大多数农村地区空气污染的主要来源。为解决数据短缺问题，我使用高分辨率卫星数据构建了中国1公里×1公里分辨率的农业火灾及其他地理特征的精细度量。利用生物质发电厂交错式进入（这些发电厂从附近地区购买作物残留物作为生产投入）作为经济激励的冲击，我发现相对于距离较远的地区，发电厂开业后其附近的农业火灾下降了超过30%。这种下降不能由结构转型、迁移或工厂附近加强监管来解释，并且与基于激励的解释一致。然后我检验了一项禁止在机场15公里范围内进行农业火灾的命令控制政策的有效性。使用空间回归不连续设计，我没有发现该政策有效的证据。

articles.title_en: The insights and illusions of consumption measurements
articles.title_cn: 消费测量的洞见与错觉
articles.abstract_en: While household well-being derives from long-term average rates of consumption, welfare estimates rely on shorter-duration survey measurements. We develop a strategy to identify the distribution of these long-term rates by leveraging a large-scale randomization that elicited repeated short-duration measurements from diaries and recall questions. Identification stems from diary–recall differences in reports from the same household, does not require reports to be error-free, and hinges on a research design with broad replicability. Our strategy delivers practical and cost-effective suggestions for designing survey modules to yield the closest measurements of household well-being. We find little empirical support for the claim that acquisition diaries yield the most accurate measurement of poverty and inequality and offer new insights to interpret and reconcile diary–recall differences in household surveys.
articles.abstract_cn: 尽管家庭福祉源自长期平均消费率，但福利估计依赖于较短时段的调查测量。我们开发了一种策略，通过利用大规模随机化，从日记和回忆问题中获取重复的短期测量，来识别这些长期率的分布。识别源于同一家庭在日记与回忆报告之间的差异，不要求报告无误差，并依赖于具有广泛可复制性的研究设计。我们的策略为设计调查模块提供了实用且成本效益高的建议，以最接近地测量家庭福祉。我们发现，几乎没有实证支持获取日记能产生最准确的贫困和不平等测量的说法，并为解释和调和家庭调查中日记与回忆差异提供了新的洞见。

articles.title_en: Experience in financial decision-making: Field evidence from Malawi
articles.abstract_en: Fifty-three percent of subjects who owned a high-fee account with a local bank in Malawi did not switch to a new, lower-fee account when given the choice. In contrast, holders of high-fee accounts who had been induced to make more transactions in the past were significantly more likely to adopt the new, cheaper account. Using estimates from a structural model, we find that the different propensity to switch is better explained by differences in the valuation of the new account rather than differences in the cost of switching. Experience using financial products can thus improve financial decision making.

excluded_items.title_en: He said, she said: The impact of gender and marriage perceptions on self and proxy reporting of labor
